model.use: noncommercial research and evaluation; weights remain local

inference.resize_policy: Pinned pretrained processor default; square resize stretches 640x360 RGB
inference.output_policy: Bilinear resize logits to original image dimensions with align_corners=false, then argmax

comparison.unsupported_display: amber hatch; excluded from shared-class scores and counted explicitly
comparison.quality_gate: No accuracy acceptance threshold: exploratory frozen-model domain-transfer preview

model.license_name: NVIDIA Source Code License for SegFormer; noncommercial research/evaluation

latency_seconds.scope: CPU preprocessing + forward + logits resize/argmax, excludes rendering and file IO; first includes warmup

aggregate.metric_scope: Pixel metrics on GT background/drivable/vehicle/pedestrian only; GT lane and generic-obstacle pixels are unsupported and excluded. Background is a coarse aggregation of other Cityscapes categories, including rider. This is saved-frame domain-transfer preview, not driving acceptance.
